title: Velvety Herbal Peruvian French Praline Tart
description: A rich and creamy tart featuring the unique flavors of Peruvian herbs and French praline. Perfect for a date-night dessert.
instructions: Line a 9-inch (23 cm) tart pan with parchment paper
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, powdered sugar, and salt.
Add the coconut oil and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into the prepared tart pan and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until lightly golden.
In a blender, combine the date syrup, hibiscus flowers, lemon juice, matcha powder, and unsweetened almond milk. Blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the praline paste and coconut oil until well combined.
Pour the date mixture into the baked tart shell and smooth the top.
Drizzle the praline mixture over the top and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
Bake for an additional 10-12 minutes or until the filling is set.
Let the tart cool completely before serving.
